tasks.label: Run all checks
tasks.detail: The checks CI runs: lint, format, types, tests.
tasks.command: uv run ruff check && uv run ruff format --check && uv run pyright && uv run pytest

tasks.label: Preview docs
tasks.detail: Serves the docs and reloads them as you edit.
tasks.command: uv run --group docs sphinx-autobuild docs docs/_build/html --watch src --open-browser
